paper_metadata.journal: Journal of Materials Engineering and Performance

evidence.quote: (3) A parameter called the eutectic influence factor E, which is the product of the volume fraction and size of the eutectic, is used to evaluate the effect of eutectic characteristics on hot-tearing susceptibility: E ¼ Se /C3 Ve where Se represents the average size of eutectic and V e is the volume fraction of eutectic. The value of E agrees with the hot-tearing susceptibility well.
